layers.name: Frontend Foundations
layers.definitionOfDone: No secrets in client bundle; all AI/render calls go through ShortForge control plane; QuickGenerate decomposed; streaming/polling states active.

layers.name: APIs & Backend Logic
layers.definitionOfDone: Single fenced commit path (worker -> result.json + sha256 -> fenced callback -> verifier -> CAS -> control plane); zero worker Firestore writes; zero synthetic URLs.

layers.name: Database & Storage
layers.definitionOfDone: Artifact bytes live in SHA-256 CAS and object storage; DB stores hashes/metadata; CAS publish only after F06/F07 verification.

layers.name: Auth & Permissions
layers.definitionOfDone: Per-worker HMAC secrets, timing-safe auth, attemptId equality fencing, lease expiry, and runtime authority registry enforcement.

layers.name: Hosting & Deployment
layers.definitionOfDone: Separate dev/preview/prod environments, long renders decoupled from serverless timeouts, documented rollback, and repo outside OneDrive sync.

layers.name: Cloud & Compute
layers.definitionOfDone: All renders (including 138s+ quizzes) traverse fenced ComputeRouter/InstaBox routing with deterministic 48k/30fps media core and zero forbidden patterns.

layers.name: CI/CD & Version Control
layers.definitionOfDone: CI and pre-commit enforce okf:authority charter drift lock, ruff F821/F811/F401 undefined-name gate, and P2 media gate suite.

layers.name: Security & RLS
layers.definitionOfDone: All external fetches SSRF-guarded (including _download_image), path containment enforced at F06, and zero hardcoded secrets.

layers.name: Rate Limiting & Quotas
layers.definitionOfDone: Treasurer reserve/settle/freeze enforced on all compute/model admissions; bounded backoff; hard spend caps evidenced.

layers.name: Caching & CDN
layers.definitionOfDone: Image cache keys include model + dimensions + steps + toolchain hash; pinned hashed fonts manifest verified at preflight.

layers.name: Load Balancing & Scaling
layers.definitionOfDone: 11-node fleet concurrency verified; 1,000-job unified-path soak (S1 >= 99.9%) evidenced.

layers.name: Error Tracking & Logs
layers.definitionOfDone: Structured correlationId/jobId/executionId logs across Python and Next.js; telemetry on yield, escape rate, loudness, drift, and spend.

layers.name: Availability & Recovery
layers.definitionOfDone: Fail-closed worker/upload/preflight/FLUX handling; 12 unconditional F06 gates + F07 audit prevent silent degraded shipping.
